# THE TOOL DOOR'S WIRE WORDS (door_steps.rs) -- golden input data, one `key = value` per line (`#`
# starts a comment). These are the linked plane's own words that its Statement does not carry: the
# request headers a call states, the revision it speaks, the section its grammar reads, the record
# kind and billable class a served call is ledgered under, and the digest the section approves for
# the one tool the test server lists (`read_file`, "reads a file from disk", an object schema with
# one string `path` property).
#
# Copied from the line-served plane's own sources: codec.rs (H_MCP_METHOD, H_MCP_NAME,
# H_PROTOCOL_VERSION, PROTOCOL_VERSION), tools_config.rs (SECTION), tool_records.rs (KIND_CALL),
# tool_meta.rs (CLASS_TOOL_CALLS, CLASS_BYTES); tool_digest is `trust::tool_digest` over the inputs
# above.
# write_digest and stat_digest are `trust::tool_digest` of `write_file` ("writes a file to disk") and
# `stat` ("reads a file's metadata"), the same schema; scope_server and scope_tool are the two grant
# kinds door.rs states (SCOPE, SCOPE_TOOL).
method_header = mcp-method
name_header = mcp-name
protocol_header = mcp-protocol-version
protocol_version = 2026-07-28
section = tools
record_kind_call = call
class_tool_calls = tool_calls
class_bytes = bytes
tool_digest = sha256:6d51ebb1b3730422e414cf22c039874e7274e1103a22e6d5819abcfcab9e09cb
# The subscription channel (subscribe.rs ACKNOWLEDGED, SUBSCRIPTION_ID; codec.rs
# METHOD_SUBSCRIPTIONS_LISTEN; the list-changed notification of tools).
listen_method = subscriptions/listen
acknowledged = notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged
tools_changed = notifications/tools/list_changed
subscription_id = io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId
write_digest = sha256:24844171892a7e325ada2a8675924de9bb83bdbbdf59dfd25af5f8c943982280
stat_digest = sha256:2785b922e1a5cf2b6d36fc7490ba4522cf931c997d53cfae566e1e9509665bfa
scope_server = mcp_server
scope_tool = mcp_tool
# The endpoint block the door owns beside its declaring section (door.rs ENDPOINT_SECTION).
endpoint_section = mcp
# The registry key the plane files its per-entry hooks under (lib.rs PLANE_KEY).
plane_key = mcp
# The audit row a tools/call writes on the kernel's audit chain (call.rs ACTION_TOOL_CALL, and the
# resource noun AuditRow::tool names a tool by: `<noun>:<published name>`).
audit_action_tool_call = mcp_tool.call
audit_resource_tool = mcp_tool
# The plane's refusal words for an exhausted walk, byte for byte as predev served them (tool_door.rs
# RefusalSlot; the `*_in_predevs_bytes` cells in serve_tests.rs): a tripped server's sentence
# ({server} and {wait} filled by the cell), and a task continuation the walk refused. {PLANE} is the
# plane's own key above (`plane_key`), upper-cased, as its sentences spell it.
tripped_server_message = {PLANE} server `{server}` is unavailable: its circuit breaker is open after repeated failures; busbar did not dispatch this call. Retry after {wait}s.
continuation_refused_error = {"code":-32603,"message":"the {PLANE} upstream call failed: breaker_open"}
